rules.title: Berkeley rent control coverage (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to fully covered units: most multifamily units built before 1980, single family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. Newer construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, condominiums and certain subsidized units are only partially covered and have no rent control. The guide gives no cap amount.
rules.coverage_text: Most multifamily units built before 1980; single family homes with tenancies beginning before 1996; rooming houses (five or more rooms rented individually with separate leases).

exemption_tests.description: Units built and given a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 have no rent control (partially covered).
Single-family home with tenancy beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, and Section 202/811 or HUD-insured Rental Supplement/Section 8 subsidized units have no rent control.
Golden Duplex: duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, with an owner currently living in one unit (exempt).
Owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started (exempt).
Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU and one owner-occupied unit (exempt).
University rental units such as dormitories (exempt).

rules.exemptions_text: Exempt: Golden Duplex; owner shares kitchen/bath; ADU property with owner-occupancy for tenancies after Nov 7, 2018; university rental units; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – Guide to Coverage
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.ambiguity_note: Summary guide only; states it is a guide and individual circumstances may differ. No cap amount given.

rules.title: Berkeley just cause for eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to fully covered and partially covered units, including new construction after June 1980, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain subsidized units. Exempt units are not covered.
rules.coverage_text: All non-exempt units: pre-1980 multifamily, single family homes, rooming houses, new construction (CO after June 1980), most condominiums, and certain subsidized units.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest coverage
rules.requirement: Security deposit interest requirements apply to fully and partially covered units, but not to exempt units. The guide does not state the interest rate or procedure.
